description: An ultra-compact and highly affordable battery-electric city hatchback built on BYD's e-Platform 3.0. It features an angular 'ocean-inspired' design, ultra-safe Blade Battery technology, and advanced tech like a rotating touchscreen. The latest generation brings premium additions like a high-power front motor, ultra-fast flash charging, and a luxurious cabin with heated/ventilated massaging seats.

A highly reliable and fuel-efficient compact sedan perfect for daily commutes. Features a comfortable five-seat cabin, an intuitive infotainment system, and standard advanced safety features including lane-keep assist and pre-collision braking.

A fully electric compact crossover SUV combining modern European design with ample cabin space. Offers a quiet ride, a large panoramic glass roof, and a high-tech digital cockpit with an expansive center touchscreen and wireless connectivity.

A stylish electric compact SUV built on BYD's e-Platform 3.0. Highlights include a unique gym-inspired interior aesthetic, a signature rotating touchscreen display, and a robust Blade Battery pack delivering impressive range and rapid charging capabilities.

A bold and contemporary compact crossover SUV featuring a spacious dual-screen dashboard design. Delivers a smooth and capable ride with versatile folding rear seats, advanced driver assist systems, and substantial cargo capacity.

An ultra-nimble micro-electric vehicle designed specifically for tight urban navigation. Extremely easy to park, it offers basic four-seat practicality, low power consumption, and efficient charging from standard household power outlets.

A premium all-electric sedan delivering quick acceleration, precise sports handling, and a minimalist interior. Controlled entirely via a central 15-inch touchscreen display, it comes equipped with basic Autopilot capabilities and superb battery efficiency.

A practical and legendary compact subcompact hatchback built for crowded city streets. Highly favored for its unmatched fuel savings, tight turning radius, easy parking maneuverability, and straightforward dashboard layout.

A modern crossover SUV with aggressive geometric exterior styling. Features a premium five-seat layout, cutting-edge infotainment, and robust multi-terrain capabilities suited perfectly for both urban environments and weekend road trips.
